name: Battle of Hillsbrad
label: Quest
description: In Hillsbrad, Forsaken forces press their assault south. After strikes on the northern farms, Horde operatives hunt the peasants fleeing to the orchards.

clips.title: The story
paras: In Hillsbrad, Forsaken forces press their assault south. After strikes on the northern farms, Horde operatives hunt the peasants fleeing to the orchards.

The attack on Hillsbrad's human farms drives laborers south into the fields. After the northern farms are struck, many flee to the orchards and pastures of Hillsbrad Fields, hoping to escape the advancing undead. High Executor Darthalia sees their flight as a chance to break the township's remaining labor force and morale.

From Tarren Mill, High Executor Darthalia orders Horde forces to hunt the displaced laborers in the fields. The peasants have no protection, and their deaths choke Hillsbrad's food supply and weaken civilian resolve. For Darthalia and the Forsaken, each human killed tightens their hold over the surviving township and helps keep Lordaeron in Forsaken hands.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Word of the attack on the northern farms has the townsfolk panicked. Most excellent.
Our Deathstalkers report peasants fleeing to the fields in southern Hillsbrad. The fools think they can hide in the orchards and escape their doom.
Prove them wrong, friend. Return to Hillsbrad Fields and seek out the cowering peasants. Lay waste to them in the name of our Dark Lady.

clips.title: Progress
paras: You have your orders, adventurer. Quit dawdling here in Tarren Mill when there is work to be done elsewhere.

clips.title: Completion
paras: The grip of death is tightening around the town of Hillsbrad. The battle goes well.
